overview: The order Perissodactyla includes living horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses alongside many extinct branches. Fossils place its early radiation during the PETM, but the sampled record and analyses do not resolve the order’s exact origin.

ecology.habitat: Lineage-specific terrestrial habitats; no single order-wide habitat
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial, with strongly divergent limb specializations
ecology.bodySize: Small early forms to giant rhinocerotoids
ecology.guild: Browsers, mixed feeders and grazers in separate lineages

traits: Early branches distinguished by subtle dental and cranial characters
Strong lineage-specific divergence of skull, dentition and limbs
evidenceSummary: The PETM occurrence study and broader fossil synthesis trace a branching history across northern continents. They do not date the order’s exact origin or describe one way of life for every branch.

title.en: Earliest perissodactyls reveal large-scale dispersals during the PETM
title.zh: Earliest perissodactyls reveal large-scale dispersals during the PETM

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Evolutionary Transitions in the Fossil Record of Terrestrial Hoofed Mammals
title.zh: Evolutionary Transitions in the Fossil Record of Terrestrial Hoofed Mammals

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Perissodactyl evolution
title.zh: Perissodactyl evolution

scope.en: The selected anatomical, relationship or time-estimate material described in this account; no complete species history or distribution is inferred.
scope.zh: 用于本文选取的解剖、关系或时间估计材料，不由此推断完整物种史或分布。

title.en: Different bodies on separate branches
title.zh: 不同支系，各有形貌

text.zh: 今天的马、貘和犀牛外形差异很大。早期化石的区分常依靠牙齿和头骨的细微特征，许多灭绝支系又呈现了更多变化。它们共同组成分支演化记录，而不是只通向现生类群的连续队列。
text.en: Horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses look very different today. Early fossils can be distinguished by finer features of their teeth and skulls, while many extinct branches add still more variation. Together they form a branching record rather than a sequence leading only to the living forms.

title.zh: 如何复原早期亲缘关系
title.en: How early relationships are reconstructed

text.zh: 牙齿和头骨的小差异帮助研究者比较早期支系。最早出现记录研究分析了 71 个末端和 102 个形态字符；基部位置在不同分析中的变化说明，最早化石并未解决奇蹄目的起源。
text.en: Small differences in teeth and skulls help researchers compare early branches. The study of earliest occurrences analyzes 71 terminals and 102 morphological characters; alternative basal placements show why the order’s first fossils do not settle its origin.

title.zh: 每条谱系都有自己的历史
title.en: Each lineage has its own history

text.zh: 奇蹄目包含许多灭绝类群。牙齿、头骨和四肢沿不同支系发生变化，其中一些后来成为马、貘和犀牛。若把化石按年代排成连续祖先队列，就会掩盖这种分支格局。
text.en: The order includes many extinct groups. Teeth, skulls and limbs changed along different branches, which later included horses, tapirs and rhinoceroses. A list of fossils arranged as successive ancestors would hide this branching pattern.

title.zh: 极热事件期间的扩散，起源仍未解决
title.en: Dispersal during the PETM, origin unresolved

text.zh: 最早取样的奇蹄类记录约为 5600 万至 5400 万年前，处于古新世—始新世极热事件期间。它们的分布支持北美、欧洲和亚洲之间发生快速扩散，但没有确定奇蹄目的确切起源地。
text.en: The earliest sampled perissodactyl records fall around 56–54 Ma, during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum. Their distribution supports rapid dispersal among North America, Europe and Asia, but does not identify the order’s exact place of origin.

readerLimitations.en: The early radiation is reconstructed from sampled fossils and comparative anatomy. Basal placements depend on analysis, and the selected records do not identify direct ancestors, a precise origin date or a complete distribution.
readerLimitations.zh: 早期辐射的复原依据是所取样化石与比较形态。基部位置会随分析而变，所选记录不能确定直系祖先、精确起源年代或完整分布。

overviewZh: 奇蹄目包括现生马、貘和犀牛，也包括许多已灭绝支系。化石将其早期辐射置于古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）期间，但取样记录和分析未能确定本目确切的起源。
evidenceSummaryZh: 古新世—始新世极热事件（PETM）的产出研究与更广泛的化石综述，追踪了该目在北方大陆的分支演化历史。它们没有确定该目的确切起源时间，也没有描述所有分支共同的生活方式。

overview: Brontotheriidae ranged widely in form during the Eocene. Members share cranial and molar features, including a shortened face and distinctive upper molars, yet early forms were small while later species could reach rhinoceros size. Some species had frontonasal appendages and others did not. The family-level pattern helps identify brontotheres; it should not be mistaken for a description of every species.
overviewZh: 始新世的 Brontotheriidae 在体型和头部外观上差异很大。成员共享一些头骨与臼齿特征，包括缩短的吻部和独特的上臼齿；早期类型较小，后期有些种可达犀牛大小。额鼻部附属突起只见于部分种。科级特征有助于识别雷兽类，却不能当作每个种的共同画像。

ecology.diet: Brontotheres were herbivores; leaf browsing is supported by the sampled teeth.
ecology.habitat: The cited records are from terrestrial Eocene localities; they do not define one habitat for the whole family.
ecology.locomotion: The family is terrestrial, but the cited evidence does not establish one gait for every member.
ecology.bodySize: The documented size range runs from small early forms to rhinoceros-sized later taxa.
ecology.guild: The sampled dental evidence contains a leaf-browsing signal.
ecology.dietZh: 雷兽类是草食动物；取样牙齿支持其取食叶片。
ecology.habitatZh: 所引记录来自始新世陆生化石地点；它们不能界定整个雷兽科共同的单一生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 该科为陆生，但所引证据无法确定所有成员共有的一种步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 记录的体型范围从早期的小型类型到后期的犀牛大小类群。
ecology.guildZh: 所取样的牙齿证据显示出取食叶片的信号。

traits: The face is shortened from front to back in the family-level diagnosis.
The postorbital part of the skull is elongate.
Upper molars are bunoselenodont, with a W-shaped outer ridge (ectoloph).
Frontonasal appendages occur in some species, not across the family.
evidenceSummary: Mihlbachler’s monograph supplies the taxonomy, morphology and distribution summarized here. Size and frontonasal appendages vary among species, while dispersal direction and deeper relationships are reconstructions rather than shared diagnostic observations.
evidenceSummaryZh: 本页的分类、形态和分布依据 Mihlbachler 的专著。体型及额鼻部附属突起因种而异；扩散方向和深层亲缘关系则是复原结果，并非共同诊断观察。

readerLimitations.en: The monograph shows substantial variation across species: early forms were smaller, later forms could reach rhinoceros size, and frontonasal appendages occur only in some. Dental browsing evidence and terrestrial Eocene localities do not imply one habitat or gait for the whole family.
readerLimitations.zh: 专著记录了明显的种间差异：早期类型较小，晚期有些可达犀牛大小，额鼻部附属突起也只见于部分种。牙齿中的取食线索和始新世陆生地点，不能推出全科共享一种栖地或步态。

traitsZh: 科级鉴定特征包括前后方向缩短的面部。
眼眶之后的颅骨部分较长。
上臼齿呈丘形—月形结构，外侧脊（外脊）呈 W 形。
某些物种具有额鼻部附属结构，但这并非全科共有。

geography: Western Europe (French and British study records)
overview: This Palaeotherium account separates dental evidence from the genus’s regional history. Wear in the sampled Palaeotherium medium from La Débruge is consistent with leaf browsing and a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component; separate British records place regional losses near the Grande Coupure, not a global extinction instant.

ecology.diet: In sampled Palaeotherium medium, dental wear supports leaf browsing with a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component.
ecology.habitat: La Débruge is a late Eocene terrestrial locality; tooth wear alone does not reconstruct the animal’s habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The cited dental-wear study does not evaluate gait.
ecology.bodySize: The evidence is for sampled Palaeotherium medium; it does not provide a genus-wide size estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled Palaeotherium medium population is described as a leaf browser; this is not a genus-wide assignment.
ecology.dietZh: 在取样的 Palaeotherium medium 中，牙齿磨耗支持以浏览取食叶片为主的混合食性，另有较少的果实或具磨蚀性的种子成分。
ecology.habitatZh: La Débruge 是晚始新世陆生化石地点；仅凭齿面磨耗不能重建动物的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引牙齿磨损研究没有评估步态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 证据仅涉及取样的 Palaeotherium medium，不能提供整个属的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 所取样的 Palaeotherium medium 种群被描述为食叶者；这一归类不适用于整个属。

traits: The molars have high occlusal relief.
Worn cusps include both sharp and rounded forms.
Wear facets are consistent with both shearing and grinding plant foods.
evidenceSummary: Joomun and colleagues analyze dental wear in one species and locality; Hooker and colleagues provide a separate British regional range chart. Neither source gives a complete global genus history, and the local last appearances do not date a single global extinction.
overviewZh: 本页将牙齿证据与 Palaeotherium 的区域历史分开。来自 La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 取样牙齿磨耗与食叶相符，另有较少的果实或具磨蚀性种子成分；英国的独立记录将区域性消失置于 Grande Coupure 附近，而不是一个全球灭绝时点。
evidenceSummaryZh: Joomun 等人分析一个物种、一个地点的牙齿磨耗；Hooker 等人另提供英国区域分布范围图。两项来源都没有给出该属完整的全球历史，局部末次出现也不能确定单一的全球灭绝时间。

readerSources.title: Dental wear variation and implications for diet: An example from Eocene perissodactyls (Mammalia)

scope.en: Joomun et al. (2008), pp. 92–106, Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–4: dental wear in the La Débruge Palaeotherium medium sample and the resulting dietary interpretation.
scope.zh: Joomun 等（2008），第 92–106 页、图 1–8 与表 1–4：La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 样本牙齿磨耗及据此作出的食性解释。

readerSources.title: Eocene–Oligocene mammalian faunal turnover in the Hampshire Basin, UK: calibration to the global time scale and the major cooling event

scope.en: Hooker et al. (2004), pp. 161–172, Figures 2–4 and the mammal range chart: British regional records and losses around the Grande Coupure, not a global extinction date.
scope.zh: Hooker 等（2004），第 161–172 页、图 2–4 与哺乳动物分布图：英国区域记录及 Grande Coupure 前后的消失，不是全球灭绝年代。

title.en: La Débruge tooth wear and the Grande Coupure
title.zh: La Débruge 牙齿磨耗与 Grande Coupure

text.en: This Palaeotherium account separates dental evidence from the genus’s regional history. Wear in the sampled Palaeotherium medium from La Débruge is consistent with leaf browsing and a smaller fruit or abrasive-seed component; separate British records place regional losses near the Grande Coupure, not a global extinction instant.
text.zh: 本页将牙齿证据与 Palaeotherium 的区域历史分开。来自 La Débruge 的 Palaeotherium medium 取样牙齿磨耗与食叶相符，另有较少的果实或具磨蚀性种子成分；英国的独立记录将区域性消失置于 Grande Coupure 附近，而不是一个全球灭绝时点。

title.en: One species sample and separate British range records
title.zh: 单一物种样本与独立的英国分布记录

text.en: Joomun and colleagues analyze dental wear in one species and locality; Hooker and colleagues provide a separate British regional range chart. Neither source gives a complete global genus history, and the local last appearances do not date a single global extinction.
text.zh: Joomun 等人分析一个物种、一个地点的牙齿磨耗；Hooker 等人另提供英国区域分布范围图。两项来源都没有给出该属完整的全球历史，局部末次出现也不能确定单一的全球灭绝时间。

traitsZh: 臼齿具有较高的咬合面起伏。
磨耗的齿尖既有尖锐型，也有圆钝型。
磨耗面特征符合对植物性食物同时进行剪切和研磨。

geography: Badlands National Park, South Dakota (sampled M. planifrons)
overview: Metamynodon planifrons is the subject of a comparative test of semi-aquatic movement. The anatomy and deposits bear on how this one amynodontid may have moved; they do not justify calling the whole family “swamp rhinos.”

ecology.diet: Herbivorous; diet not tested in the locomotor study
ecology.locomotion: Semi-aquatic inference from comparative anatomy and deposits
ecology.bodySize: Large M. planifrons sample; genus-wide mass not generalized
ecology.guild: No feeding guild assigned beyond the bounded locomotor inference

traits: High-positioned orbits
Reduced thoracic neural spines
Limb-lever proportions differing from more terrestrial amynodontids
evidenceSummary: Wall and Heinbaugh compare eye position, the spine and limb proportions with other amynodontids. These anatomical differences and the sedimentary setting support a semi-aquatic interpretation, but neither directly records the animal’s behavior.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: Metamynodon planifrons is the subject of a comparative test of semi-aquatic movement. The anatomy and deposits bear on how this one amynodontid may have moved; they do not justify calling the whole family “swamp rhinos.”
text.zh: Metamynodon planifrons 是一项半水生运动比较研究的对象。骨骼结构和沉积记录有助于讨论这一个种可能怎样运动；它们不足以把整个两栖犀科称作沼泽犀牛。

title.en: Anatomy used to test movement
title.zh: 用于检验运动方式的解剖

text.en:
In the studied Metamynodon planifrons material, the orbits sit high on the skull and the thoracic neural spines are shortened.

Its limb-bone lever proportions differ from those of the more terrestrial amynodontids used in the comparison. These observations concern the study material.
text.zh:
眼眶位置较高。

胸椎神经棘缩短。

肢骨杠杆比例不同于更偏陆生的两栖犀类。

title.en: A semi-aquatic test, not observed behaviour
title.zh: 半水生运动检验，而非行为实录

text.en: The sampled M. planifrons material is associated with Orellan channel sandstones. Comparative anatomy and deposits are used to test semi-aquatic movement, but neither directly records behaviour; the locomotor study does not test diet or yield a genus-wide mass estimate or feeding guild.
text.zh: 所取样的 M. planifrons 材料与奥雷尔阶河道砂岩有关。研究用比较解剖和沉积背景检验半水生运动假说，但两者都未直接记录行为；运动研究没有检验食性，也未得出全属体重估计或取食功能群。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: Wall and Heinbaugh compare eye position, the spine and limb proportions with other amynodontids. These anatomical differences and the sedimentary setting support a semi-aquatic interpretation, but neither directly records the animal’s behavior.
text.zh: Wall 和 Heinbaugh 将眼眶位置、神经棘及肢骨比例与其他两栖犀类比较。这些解剖差异和沉积环境支持半水生解释，但两者都没有直接记录动物的行为。

title.en: Locomotor adaptations in Metamynodon planifrons compared to other amynodontids (Perissodactyla, Rhinocerotoidea)
title.zh: Locomotor adaptations in Metamynodon planifrons compared to other amynodontids (Perissodactyla, Rhinocerotoidea)

scope.en: Comparative anatomy tests semi-aquatic locomotion in M. planifrons; behaviour is not directly observed.
scope.zh: 比较解剖用于检验 M. planifrons 的半水生运动方式；行为并未直接观察。

title.en: Amynodontidae
title.zh: Amynodontidae

scope.en: Provides family-level amynodont context; it does not replace the comparative locomotor test for M. planifrons.
scope.zh: 提供两栖犀科的一般背景；它不能替代对 M. planifrons 运动方式的比较检验。

overview: Paraceratherium is an Oligocene Asian genus represented here by six sampled species. A 155-character analysis places the 26.5 Ma Paraceratherium linxiaense specimen LX1808 within a monophyletic genus, although detailed relationships depend on that matrix. Its skull, mandible and neck vertebrae support a giant, long-necked animal with long limbs.
overviewZh: Paraceratherium 是渐新世亚洲的一个属，这里取样了六个物种。155 个性状的分析将年代约 26.5 Ma 的 Paraceratherium linxiaense 标本 LX1808 置于单系的属内，但更细的属内关系依赖该矩阵。头骨、下颌和颈椎支持其体型巨大、颈部长且四肢较长。

ecology.diet: A large terrestrial herbivore; feeding height is inferred from neck and body form, not measured.
ecology.habitat: Oligocene Asian woodland–grassland mosaics are reported for sampled localities; settings vary by locality.
ecology.locomotion: The long limbs do not fit the elephant-like, short-limbed graviportal analogy rejected in the cited study.
ecology.bodySize: Giant-bodied; the profile does not infer a more precise mass.
ecology.guild: A large browser is an anatomical inference; diet was not directly measured.
ecology.dietZh: 一种大型陆生草食动物；其取食高度是根据颈部和身体形态推断的，并未测量。
ecology.habitatZh: 所取样地点记录了渐新世亚洲林地—草地镶嵌景观；不同地点的环境各异。
ecology.locomotionZh: 其长肢与象类短肢、重型承重动物式的类比不符；所引研究也否定了这种类比。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型巨大；该简介没有推算更精确的体重。
ecology.guildZh: 大型食叶者是根据解剖特征作出的推断；并未直接测量其食性。

traits: Giant skull and body size
Long, flexible neck supported by cervical anatomy
Long limbs rather than stubby graviportal limbs
Species diagnoses use cranial and dental characters
evidenceSummary: Deng and colleagues provide the dated LX1808 specimen, diagnosis, 155-character analysis and occurrence map. The analysis samples six species and supports a monophyletic genus; a Tibetan-region dispersal route, palaeoelevation and feeding height remain inferences.

readerLimitations.en: LX1808 is a point occurrence, not the genus’ global first or last appearance. Locality records span the Mongolian Plateau, northwestern China, Kazakhstan and Pakistan; routes through the Tibetan region and palaeoelevation are reconstructed, not directly recorded. Herbivory is supported, but browsing height and a single habitat for every species are not established.
readerLimitations.zh: LX1808 是一个地点的产出记录，并非该属的全球首末现。已列地点包括蒙古高原、中国西北、哈萨克斯坦和巴基斯坦；经青藏地区的扩散路线与古海拔属于重建结果，并非直接记录。食草解释有依据，但取食高度以及全属统一的生境尚未确定。

evidenceSummaryZh: Deng 等人提供了有年代约束的 LX1808 标本、鉴定特征、155 项特征分析和产出分布图。分析取样了六个物种并支持将该属视为单系群；经由西藏地区扩散、古海拔及取食高度仍属推断。
traitsZh: 颈椎解剖特征支持其具有长而灵活的颈部。
肢体较长，而非粗短的重型承重型肢体。
物种鉴定依据颅骨和牙齿特征。

overview: This genus-level Chalicotherium profile follows dental-wear samples labelled Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande. It keeps that source taxonomy visible rather than treating every sample as one undifferentiated species.
overviewZh: 这份属级 Chalicotherium 档案依据牙齿磨耗样本，样本标签包括 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合名 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande。这里保留研究使用的分类名称；不能把不同名称下的样本不加区分地当作同一个物种。

ecology.diet: Wear evidence supports browsing, with abrasive bark or twig material among the proposed foods.
ecology.habitat: The samples come from Miocene sites in southern Germany. Diet alone does not identify the habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Posture is reconstructed from limb anatomy, not observed directly.
ecology.bodySize: The sampled animals are large chalicotheriines; the cited study does not give a genus-wide mass estimate.
ecology.guild: The dietary evidence suggests a browser with mixed food textures; the full feeding guild remains an interpretation.
ecology.dietZh: 磨耗证据支持其取食叶片、枝条等；被提出的食物中包括带磨蚀性的树皮或细枝材料。
ecology.habitatZh: 样本来自德国南部的中新世遗址。仅凭食性不能确定生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 姿势是根据肢骨解剖结构重建的，并非直接观察所得。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所取样的动物属于大型爪兽亚科；所引研究没有给出该属整体的体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 食性证据提示其为取食多种不同质地食物的食叶动物；完整的摄食生态类群仍属解释。

traits: Large terminal toe bones interpreted as claws
Short hind limbs in the sampled chalicotheriines
Posture and claw use are functional reconstructions
evidenceSummary: The primary study combines mesowear and microwear evidence and states the historical names used for its samples. Tooth wear supports dietary interpretations; posture and claw function depend on anatomical reconstruction.
evidenceSummaryZh: 主研究结合了牙齿宏观和微观磨耗，并交代了样本所用的历史名称。磨耗支持食性解释；姿势和爪的功能则依赖骨骼比较与重建。

title.en: What can tooth wear tell us about these samples?
title.zh: 牙齿磨耗能揭示这些样本的什么？

text.en: This genus-level Chalicotherium profile follows dental-wear samples labelled Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande. It keeps that source taxonomy visible rather than treating every sample as one undifferentiated species.
text.zh: 这份属级 Chalicotherium 档案依据牙齿磨耗样本，样本标签包括 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合名 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande。这里保留研究使用的分类名称；不能把不同名称下的样本不加区分地当作同一个物种。

title.en: Wear supports browsing with abrasive foods
title.zh: 磨耗证据支持取食枝叶及磨蚀性食物

text.en: Mesowear and microwear in the studied southern German Miocene samples support browse-dominated feeding with mixed food textures; bark or twigs are among the proposed abrasive foods. This is a dietary inference from wear, not a directly observed meal.
text.zh: 对德国南部中新世样本的中磨耗和微磨耗分析支持以取食枝叶为主、食物质地混合的解释；树皮或嫩枝是提出的磨蚀性食物之一。这是根据磨耗作出的食性推断，并非直接观察到的一餐。

title.en: Claw use and posture are reconstructions
title.zh: 爪的用途与姿势属于重建

text.en: The sampled animals are large chalicotheriines. Samples identified as Chalicotherium goldfussi and the historical combination Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande preserve large terminal toe bones interpreted as claws and shortened hind limbs. Upright posture and claw use remain functional reconstructions.
text.zh: 所研究的是大型爪兽亚科动物。鉴定为 Chalicotherium goldfussi 和历史组合 Chalicotherium (Anisodon) grande 的样本保存了大型趾末节骨（被解释为爪）以及缩短的后肢。直立姿势和爪的用途仍是功能重建。

title.en: Feeding ecology of the Chalicotheriidae (Mammalia, Perissodactyla, Ancylopoda): results from dental micro- and mesowear analyses
title.zh: Feeding ecology of the Chalicotheriidae (Mammalia, Perissodactyla, Ancylopoda): results from dental micro- and mesowear analyses

scope.en: Schulz et al. (2007), pp. 5?23, Figures 1, 5 and 6 and Tables 2?7: sample names, dental-wear evidence, browse and bark/twig interpretation, ungual phalanges and reconstructed posture.

readerLimitations.en: These conclusions are tied to sampled Miocene localities in southern Germany and the names used in the study. They do not establish a genus-wide mass estimate, global range or one complete feeding guild.
readerLimitations.zh: 这些解释仅适用于德国南部中新世取样地点及研究采用的名称，不能据此确定整个属的体重估计、全球分布范围或完整的取食类群。

traitsZh: 末端趾骨较大，被解释为爪。
所取样爪兽亚科成员的后肢较短。
姿势和爪的用途属于功能性重建。

geography: Central and western Europe (MN3–MN9 record discussed)
overview: The ecological result here concerns Anchitherium aurelianense at Sandelzhausen: wear on 35 cheek teeth supports browse-dominated mixed feeding. The separate MN3–MN9 record describes the European biochronological sample, not one global genus-wide ecology.

ecology.diet: Mesowear on 35 cheek teeth supports browse-dominated mixed feeding rather than a uniform pure-browser model at this locality.
ecology.habitat: The dietary sample comes from Sandelzhausen in a warm-temperate woodland context; it does not summarize habitat across the genus.
ecology.locomotion: The cited diagnosis records a three-toed manus and reduced fifth metacarpal; running performance is not tested.
ecology.bodySize: The selected evidence provides no single genus-wide mass estimate.
ecology.guild: The sampled teeth support browse-dominated mixed feeding; they do not assign one feeding guild to every Anchitherium population.
ecology.dietZh: 对 35 颗颊齿的中齿磨损分析支持其以取食树叶为主的混合食性；在该地点，这不支持所有个体都为纯食叶者的统一模式。
ecology.habitatZh: 摄食研究样本来自 Sandelzhausen，当地处于暖温带林地环境；它不能概括整个属的栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引鉴别描述记录了三趾的前足和缩小的第五掌骨；研究未检验其奔跑能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所选证据没有提供适用于整个属的单一体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 取样牙齿支持以浏览取食树叶为主的混合食性；据此不能为每个 Anchitherium 种群都指定同一种摄食功能类群。

traits: Low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth
Tridactyl manus with reduced fifth metacarpal
Dental wear more abrasive than a pure-browser model predicts
evidenceSummary: Kaiser analyzes 35 Anchitherium aurelianense cheek teeth at Sandelzhausen and describes a European MN3–MN9 biochronological record. The study's dietary result is local to that species and sample; MN3–MN9 is not a complete global genus range or a precise endpoint.

title.en: Mesowear at Sandelzhausen
title.zh: Sandelzhausen 的牙齿磨耗

text.en: Kaiser measured wear on 35 cheek teeth from Anchitherium aurelianense at Sandelzhausen. The mesowear pattern supports browse-dominated mixed feeding rather than a uniform pure-browser model. This is one species at one locality, and the study does not isolate every influence on diet or turn the result into a genus-wide feeding label.
text.zh: Kaiser 对 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿进行中观磨耗分析。磨耗形态支持以浏览为主的混合取食，而不是统一的纯浏览者模型。结果只适用于一个地点的一个物种样本；研究没有分离饮食的所有影响，也没有把它扩展成全属的取食标签。

title.en: Teeth, hand anatomy and regional record
title.zh: 牙齿、手部与欧洲年代记录

text.en: The cited diagnosis records low-crowned lophodont cheek teeth and a three-toed manus with a reduced fifth metacarpal. The studied dietary sample sits within a European MN3–MN9 biochronological record; MN zones are European mammal-age units, not direct dates for every fossil. The study does not claim exact global endpoints or a complete North American–Eurasian distribution for Anchitherium.
text.zh: 所引诊断记录了低冠、脊褶型颊齿，以及具有三趾、第五掌骨缩小的前肢手部。研究所用的欧洲 MN3–MN9 生物年代记录，为所讨论材料提供区域背景；MN 分期是欧洲哺乳动物生物年代单位，不是每件化石的直接定年。该研究没有给出全球精确端点，也没有建立 Anchitherium 完整的欧亚与北美分布。

title.en: Anchitherium aurelianense (Equidae, Mammalia): a brachydont “dirty browser” in the community of herbivorous large mammals from Sandelzhausen (Miocene, Germany)
title.zh: Anchitherium aurelianense (Equidae, Mammalia): a brachydont “dirty browser” in the community of herbivorous large mammals from Sandelzhausen (Miocene, Germany)

scope.en: Recorded reader-passage locators: supports; pages: 131–140; figure: Figures 1–3; Table 1; quoteLocator: Diagnosis and European MN3–MN9 context (pp. 131–132); 35-tooth mesowear result and discussion (pp. 133–139)
scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 131–140; figure: Figures 1–3; Table 1; quoteLocator: Diagnosis and European MN3–MN9 context (pp. 131–132); 35-tooth mesowear result and discussion (pp. 133–139)

overviewZh: 此处的生态学结果针对 Sandelzhausen 的 Anchitherium aurelianense：35 颗颊齿的磨耗支持以取食树叶为主的混合食性。另列的 MN3–MN9 记录描述的是欧洲生物年代学样本，并非对整个属的全球生态概述。
evidenceSummaryZh: Kaiser 分析了 Sandelzhausen 的 35 枚 Anchitherium aurelianense 颊齿，并描述了欧洲 MN3–MN9 生物年代记录。该研究的食性结果仅适用于该物种和样本；MN3–MN9 并非完整的全球属级分布，也不是精确的时间端点。

regionalRanges.label: North American tribe-level range
regionalRanges.basis: The North American review and its tribe-level figure place the represented hipparionin record from approximately 17 to 2 Ma; this remains a regional review-matrix envelope.

regionalRanges.label: Old World first dispersal
regionalRanges.basis: The oldest well-supported Old World dispersal window is represented by early Hippotherium records in the Vienna Basin.

regionalRanges.label: Latest Old World regional records
regionalRanges.basis: Terminal records vary by lineage and region; the review places the latest Chinese and African hipparionins around or below 1 Ma rather than at the Holocene boundary.

overview: Hipparionini is an extinct horse tribe whose members retained three toes while diversifying into several Old World genus-level groups. Diet, body size and habitat varied across lineages and time, so no single species profile describes the whole tribe.

ecology.habitat: Forest, woodland and open settings depending on lineage and time
ecology.locomotion: Terrestrial equine locomotion with persistent side toes

traits: Persistent tridactyly
Hypsodont teeth in many lineages
Substantial body-size and dietary variation
evidenceSummary: The record separates a North American tribe-level history from Old World dispersal at 11.4–11.0 Ma and later regional occurrences. These windows and ecological comparisons describe different samples, not one continuous range or a single migration story.

title.en: Three toes persisted as diets diversified
title.zh: 三趾延续，食性却不断分化

text.en: Hipparionins retained three toes, while many lineages evolved hypsodont, or high-crowned, teeth. The reviewed Old World forms range from browsing to mixed feeding and grazing, with body size and foot proportions also varying. These traits belong to different branches and settings; they should not be combined into one fixed lifestyle for every hipparionin.
text.zh: Hipparionini 长期保留三趾足，而许多支系演化出高冠齿。旧世界综述中的类群从取食树叶到混合取食、放牧均有记录，体型和足部比例也有差异。这些性状分别属于不同支系与环境，不应合并成适用于所有三趾马的固定生活方式。

title.en: Keep the regional histories separate
title.zh: 分别阅读不同地区的历史

text.en: The atlas distinguishes a broad North American tribe-level record from the Old World dispersal interval of 11.4–11.0 Ma and later Eurasian and African records. It also retains separate, narrower range windows in the underlying evidence. These dates describe sampled records and reviews; they do not form a single continuous timeline or prove one route of migration.
text.zh: 图谱把较广的北美部落级记录，与旧世界 11.4–11.0 Ma 的扩散区间及其后欧亚、非洲记录分开处理。底层证据还保留了不同的较窄时间窗口。这些日期来自各自的化石记录与综述，不构成一条连续时间线，也不能证明唯一迁徙路线。

overviewZh: Hipparionini 是已灭绝的马族，其成员保留三趾特征，并分化为若干旧大陆的属级类群。不同支系及不同时期的食性、体型和生境各异，因此没有一种物种的特征能代表整个族。
evidenceSummaryZh: 记录分别呈现了北美族级历史、11.4–11.0 Ma 的旧大陆扩散，以及较晚的区域性产出。这些时间窗口和生态比较对应不同样本，并非一个连续分布范围或单一迁徙过程。

overview: Ecological evidence differs by locality: isotope studies portray Florida populations mainly as terrestrial, while a limited-mobility, wet-habitat signal is strongest for T. major at Ashfall. These results do not support one behavior for every Teleoceras population.

ecology.diet: Dental and isotope evidence supports grazing or mixed feeding depending on locality; no single diet describes all samples.
ecology.habitat: Evidence includes open Florida settings and the Ashfall watering-hole landscape, which are distinct local records.
ecology.locomotion: Shortened limb and foot bones are preserved, but semi-aquatic interpretation is restricted to the Ashfall evidence rather than assigned genus-wide.
ecology.bodySize: Ashfall estimates for T. major are near 785–1,110 kg; they are population- and site-specific estimates.
ecology.guild: Grazer or mixed-feeder roles are inferred locally from teeth and isotopes.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿和同位素证据显示，取食可能因地点而为食草或混合食；没有一种食谱能概括所有样本。
ecology.habitatZh: 证据分别来自佛罗里达的开阔环境和 Ashfall 的水塘景观，二者属于不同地点记录。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了缩短的肢骨和足骨，但半水生解释限于 Ashfall 的证据，不能推广到整个属。
ecology.bodySizeZh: Ashfall 的 T. major 体重估计约为 785–1,110 千克；这是特定种群和地点的估值。
ecology.guildZh: 根据不同地点的牙齿和同位素，局部推测其生态角色为食草或混合取食。

traits: Shortened limb and foot bones are preserved.
T. major at Ashfall is described as barrel-bodied.
Hypsodont molars are present.
Lower second incisors show sexual dimorphism.
evidenceSummary: Florida and Ashfall studies yield different ecological signals. Body shape alone does not decide behavior; the strongest Ashfall interpretation remains bounded to that species and locality.
overviewZh: 生态证据随地点而异：同位素研究显示佛罗里达种群主要为陆生；活动范围有限、偏好湿地环境的信号，则主要来自 Ashfall 的 T. major。这些结果不支持把一种行为套用于所有 Teleoceras 种群。
traitsZh: 标本保存有缩短的肢骨和足骨。
Ashfall 的 T. major 被描述为桶状身躯。
下颌第二门齿存在雌雄差异。
evidenceSummaryZh: 佛罗里达与 Ashfall 的研究得出不同生态信号。仅凭体形不能确定行为；最强的 Ashfall 解释仍限于该地点的该物种。

overview: Coelodonta includes species from the Tibetan Plateau and East Asia to northern Eurasia, but its ecology was not uniform. Evidence about the woolly rhinoceros C. antiquitatis should be kept separate from isotope results for other species such as C. nihowanensis.

ecology.diet: Typical grazing in C. antiquitatis; mixed feeding in some C. nihowanensis samples
ecology.habitat: Cold dry steppe for C. antiquitatis; other species and regions vary
ecology.bodySize: Large; about 2900 kg reviewed for C. antiquitatis
ecology.guild: Cold-steppe grazer in C. antiquitatis, not a genus-wide constant

traits: Long hair and dense underwool in C. antiquitatis
Low head posture and long nasal horn in C. antiquitatis
High-crowned teeth associated with abrasive grazing
evidenceSummary: The ecological review compares species and regions, while a directly dated 14.4 ka genome represents one late C. antiquitatis individual. Together they do not establish a continuous genus-wide history or an exact global extinction boundary.

title.en: Different species left different ecological signals
title.zh: 不同物种留下不同生态信号

text.en: The review describes C. antiquitatis as a cold-adapted grazer, with long hair and dense underwool, a low head posture, a long nasal horn and high-crowned teeth. Isotope samples from some C. nihowanensis populations instead indicate mixed feeding. These findings vary by species and place; neither diet should be assigned to every member of the genus.
text.zh: 综述将 C. antiquitatis 描述为适应寒冷环境的食草者，并列出长毛和浓密底绒、低头姿态、长鼻角及高冠齿等特征。部分 C. nihowanensis 同位素样本则指向混合取食。结果随物种和地点而异，不能把任何一种食性推广到整个披毛犀属。

title.en: Two records do not make a continuous range
title.zh: 两个记录不等于连续分布

text.en: The review identifies C. thibetana at 5.08 million years ago as the earliest known genus record. A separate genomic study directly dated one C. antiquitatis individual to 14.4 thousand years ago. These are a reviewed early occurrence and one dated late individual, not proof of uninterrupted presence between them or the genus's global last appearance.
text.zh: 综述把距今 508 万年的 C. thibetana 列为目前已知最早的属级记录。另一项基因组研究直接测定了一只距今 1.44 万年的 C. antiquitatis 个体。这分别是经综述的早期出现记录和一只直接测年的晚期个体，不能证明两者之间一直有披毛犀存在，也不能确定该属的全球末次出现。

title.en: Ma et al. (2024), Coelodonta paleoecology across Eurasia
title.zh: Ma 等（2024），欧亚披毛犀属古生态综述

scope.en: Species-level ecology and geography across the genus, including morphology and isotope comparisons of C. antiquitatis and C. nihowanensis; Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–2. The review supports regional variation, not one ecology shared by every species.
scope.zh: 属内物种层级的生态与地理综述，包括 C. antiquitatis 和 C. nihowanensis 的形态及同位素比较；图 1–6、表 1–2。该综述支持区域差异，不支持所有物种共享同一生态。

title.en: Guðjónsdóttir et al. (2026), one directly dated woolly rhinoceros genome
title.zh: Guðjónsdóttir 等（2026），一只直接测年的披毛犀基因组

scope.en: One directly dated 14.4 ka C. antiquitatis individual, its genome-wide diversity and runs-of-homozygosity analysis, Figures 1–3 and supplementary tables. This late individual is not a genus-wide global last appearance.
scope.zh: 一只直接测年为 14.4 ka 的 C. antiquitatis 个体、其全基因组多样性与纯合片段分析、图 1–3 和补充表格。这只晚期个体不能代表该属的全球末次出现。

overviewZh: Coelodonta 包括分布于青藏高原、东亚至欧亚大陆北部的物种，但其生态并不一致。有关披毛犀 C. antiquitatis 的证据，应与其他物种（如 C. nihowanensis）的同位素结果分开看待。
